integrity: Theorems are proved analytically for all integer n >= 3. Exact arithmetic and independent floating-point linear-algebra scripts verify finitely many cases, without claiming exhaustive or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Real finite graph edge spaces; endpoint projection constants only, although Hilbert orthogonal projections are optimal for all p. No complete intermediate-exponent formulas. Unrestricted minimizers need not be unique. Unknown equivalent unindexed prior formula.
